note: Alien voice tests for Bob (Paul, 24 October: "deep, clicky, weird and wet"). Each test asks ElevenLabs Voice Design for new voices from its description, speaking Bob's three lines; it returns three takes, saved as voices/alien-tests/<id>-<n>.mp3, and their generated_voice_id in results.json, so the chosen one can be made into a voice. Run by the Alien voice tests workflow when this file changes on main; a test renders again only when its description or text changes. The last test garbles the words, for meaning that half comes through.

tests.description: A deep, wet alien voice, very low and resonant, as if speaking through thick fluid in the throat, with slurping consonants and soft tongue clicks between the words. Nervous, stammering, startled. A strange, non-human cadence.
tests.text: [stammering] W-what the hell, Smokehouse? I've been out here for like three kalpas, metascanning intergalactic tumbleweed. Are you winding... [startled] Holy smokes! Er, ok. [nervous, under his breath] Initiating quantum control...

tests.description: An insectoid alien speaking English. A very deep voice underneath, with constant sharp mandible clicks and wet chittering on the consonants, glistening and sticky, the words slightly garbled. Frightened.

tests.description: A strange humanoid alien, halfway between human and creature. Deep and breathy, with odd pitch slides that bend in the middle of words, wet mouth sounds and clicks in the throat, a slight doubled undertone, the words a little garbled. Nervous and startled.
